rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something physically folded, crooked, or out of shape.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 tit3 sin3 waan1 kuk1 zo2

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when someone is firmly set on doing something and will not change their mind.

example.english: They are bent on quitting; there is no point trying to talk them out of it.
example.traditional: 佢鐵咗心要辭職，點勸都冇用。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tit3 zo2 sam1 jiu3 ci4 zik1 dim2 hyun3 dou1 mou5 jung6

rows.note: Use this for being annoyed or angry, rather than for physical bending or determination.

example.english: You do not need to be bent out of shape; I did not mean it.
example.traditional: 你唔使嬲，我唔係有心㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 nau1 ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a shot, throw, or aim that is inaccurate or off target.

example.english: That shot was bent off target and nearly missed.
example.traditional: 呢球射門太唔準，差啲入唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 kau4 se6 mun4 taai3 m4 zeon2 caa1 di1 jap6 m4 dou2
